name: Grauer Bär
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Hotel Grauer Bär is located on Universitätsstraße in a central Innsbruck location. The four-star hotel features 224 rooms and suites. The historic façade of the building has been combined with modern amenities. The old town with the Goldenes Dachl and the Hofburg is within walking distance. In the heart of the city, guests can enjoy a unique blend of tradition and modernity, making it an ideal starting point for exploring Innsbruck and its surroundings, including the nearby Tirol countryside.
